name: Kravyad Rasa

sections.introduction: Kravyad Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation. This is prepared from the mixture of minerals and herbs. This formulation balance vata and kapha doshas and known to treat problems related with digestion and stomach problems.
sections.ingredients:
Suddha Gandhak (Purified Sulphur) – 96 grams 
 Shuddha para (purified and processed mercury) – 48 grams 
 Tamra bhsama (copper bhsama) -12 grams 
 Loha bhsama (iron bhsama) – 12 grams 
 Baer ki lkdi – Ziziphus mauritiana’s wood 
 Arandi ke patte  – Ricinus communis’s leaves 
 Jambhiri lemon (Citrus jambhiri) 
 Pippali (Piper longum) 
 Pipplamool (Piper longum’s root) 
 Chavya (Piper retrofractum) 
 Chitrakmool (Plumbato zeylanica’s root) 
 Saunth (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Amla (Phyllanthus emblica) 
 Maricha (Piper nigrum) 
 Kala namak (black salt) 
 Suhage ke phool (borax yakshawar’s flowers) 

 Method of Preparation 

 Took the shuddha para and made its kajjali. After this mixed this kajjali into mixture of loha and tamra bhsama. 
 Then do the process of parpati parkaran, in this boiled the ingredients (in this case the above kajjali mixture) up to heating point and made its liquid. Boiled under the mild flames of baer’s wood and pour on arandi’ leaves to made parpati of the mixture. 
 Cooled it down and do the grind in mortar pestle. 
 After this process put the mixture in iron’s pot and warm it on mild fire. In the intervals during process, added little jambhiri lemon juice. 
 Know took up to 4800 grams and dry it up. 
 Then triturated up to 50 times above mixture with the kwath of herbs (pippali, pipplamool, chivya, chitrakmool, saunth and amla). 
 After then took up to similar quantity of above mixture and suhage’s flower. Added half volume of black salt and maricha in the mixture. 
 Now keep the mixture besides chanak kshara for seven days and mixed the mixture properly in mortar pestle to make fine paste. 
 Took 125 mg of the paste and made its pills.
sections.dose: 2 to 4 pills with buttermilk and sendha namak.

 Piles due to kapha 
 Stomach problems due to vata and kapha 
 Irritable bowel syndrome 
 Lethargy and body aches
sections.contraindications:
Pitta dosha enriched persons avoid this formulation. 
 Took medicine under doctor’s prescription. 


 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Kravyad Rasa 
 Reference – Rasatantra Sara (first part); edition 13; 402 – 405. 
 Introduction 
 Kravyad Rasa is an ayurvedic formulation. This is prepared from the mixture of minerals and herbs. This formulation balance vata and kapha doshas and known to treat problems related with digestion and stomach problems. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Suddha Gandhak (Purified Sulphur) – 96 grams 
 Shuddha para (purified and processed mercury) – 48 grams 
 Tamra bhsama (copper bhsama) -12 grams 
 Loha bhsama (iron bhsama) – 12 grams 
 Baer ki lkdi – Ziziphus mauritiana’s wood 
 Arandi ke patte  – Ricinus communis’s leaves 
 Jambhiri lemon (Citrus jambhiri) 
 Pippali (Piper longum) 
 Pipplamool (Piper longum’s root) 
 Chavya (Piper retrofractum) 
 Chitrakmool (Plumbato zeylanica’s root) 
 Saunth (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Amla (Phyllanthus emblica) 
 Maricha (Piper nigrum) 
 Kala namak (black salt) 
 Suhage ke phool (borax yakshawar’s flowers) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Took the shuddha para and made its kajjali. After this mixed this kajjali into mixture of loha and tamra bhsama. 
 Then do the process of parpati parkaran, in this boiled the ingredients (in this case the above kajjali mixture) up to heating point and made its liquid. Boiled under the mild flames of baer’s wood and pour on arandi’ leaves to made parpati of the mixture. 
 Cooled it down and do the grind in mortar pestle. 
 After this process put the mixture in iron’s pot and warm it on mild fire. In the intervals during process, added little jambhiri lemon juice. 
 Know took up to 4800 grams and dry it up. 
 Then triturated up to 50 times above mixture with the kwath of herbs (pippali, pipplamool, chivya, chitrakmool, saunth and amla). 
 After then took up to similar quantity of above mixture and suhage’s flower. Added half volume of black salt and maricha in the mixture. 
 Now keep the mixture besides chanak kshara for seven days and mixed the mixture properly in mortar pestle to make fine paste. 
 Took 125 mg of the paste and made its pills. 
 
 Dose 
 2 to 4 pills with buttermilk and sendha namak. 
 Indications 
 
 Digestion power 
 Ulcers due to indigestion food in the stomach 
 Piles due to kapha 
 Stomach problems due to vata and kapha 
 Irritable bowel syndrome 
 Lethargy and body aches 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 Pitta dosha enriched persons avoid this formulation. 
 Took medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
